**Limitations**

- Not a shearlet transform. The tiles borrow the cone-adapted shearlet tiling, but the coefficients are full-size images, one per tile, without the sampling of a real shearlet transform.
- The directions are even in slope, so they are closer together near the cone axes than near the diagonals.
- The noise level of each tile assumes white noise of the same strength everywhere.
- Slower than wavelet thresholding, since every tile needs its own FFTs.

**Artifacts**

- Faint directional streaks where noise lines up by chance with a tile.
- Ringing along edges at angles between two tiles, where both tiles are thresholded apart.
